cases.name: begin from inactive opens the next session with the original input as the draft
begin on an accepted target starts from its accepted draft and keeps the report
switching target while the draft is unchanged keeps the session and its return stage
switching target with a changed draft is blocked
begin withdrawn from inactive opens the next session on a withdrawn draft
begin withdrawn from a blocked review stacks a withdrawn draft on the failing mutation and keeps the report
begin withdrawn while the draft is unchanged switches target and keeps the return stage
begin withdrawn with a changed draft is blocked
begin withdrawn while replaying is illegal
accepting a withdrawal begun on an already accepted withdrawal is refused without changing the session
a draft replaces the pending replacement and previews it
withdraw drafts a withdrawal
accept inserts the draft in history order and replays from the earliest accepted target
an accepted withdrawal is replayed like any draft
accepting the original removes the accepted draft; nothing left means no replay
accepting the original of one of two drafts replays from the remaining one
accepting an unchanged draft from reviewing is refused and keeps the draft and report
discard after the base moved during editing replays the accepted drafts
restore takes one accepted draft back and replays the rest
restore of the only accepted draft leaves time travel with zero trace
restore after a cancelled replay replays the remaining drafts and clears the fault
restore of a mutation without an accepted draft is illegal
restore while a draft is being edited is illegal
a stale restore is a silent no-op
a stale draft is a silent no-op
a stale replay completion is a silent no-op
a future generation is stale too, even where the event is illegal
progress is recorded while replaying
a completed replay installs its report and drops progress
a faulted replay keeps the drafts and records the fault
a warning-only report opens the finalize prompt
choosing overwrite commits an unscoped supersede of the drafts in history order
choosing a new alternative commits a named branch with the drafts
a finalize fault revalidates on the current base and keeps the fault
a finalized commit closes the session
a base move re-resolves positions, reorders the drafts and restarts the replay
a base move while editing drops the kept report and re-previews
a base move while inactive only records the base
a base move while finalizing only records the base
a base move to the current base is stale
exit while replaying cancels the replay and closes, keeping the session id
exit while finalizing is blocked
a cancelled replay keeps the drafts and records the cancelled fault
rerun after a cancelled replay starts the replay again and clears the fault
rerun after a failed finalize revalidates although a report exists
rerun while replaying is illegal
reverting the only draft after a faulted replay clears the stale fault
an empty replay fault code is illegal
a fault code with whitespace is illegal
a fault code over 256 bytes is illegal
a fault code of exactly 256 bytes is recorded
a malformed fault code is illegal even outside its stage
an empty alternative name is illegal
an alternative name of only Unicode white space is illegal
an alternative name over 256 UTF-8 bytes is illegal
an alternative name of exactly 256 UTF-8 bytes is committed
a padded alternative name is committed verbatim, never trimmed

scenarios.name: edit, accept, replay and finalize as overwrite
a blocking report is resolved by withdrawing the failing mutation, then finalized as a new alternative
a blocking mutation is withdrawn from its history row, the review becomes ready and finalizes as overwrite
a mutation withdrawn from its row with no session open is discarded and leaves time travel
an accepted withdrawal is restored from its row and the review blocks again
restoring the only accepted draft leaves time travel
a base move restarts the replay and fences the results of the old one
discarding a fresh edit leaves time travel
a changed draft blocks switching target until it is reverted
reverting the only draft leaves nothing to finalize
a failed finalize revalidates and can be retried
a cancelled replay is rerun when the next edit is discarded
a cancelled replay is rerun and finalized
a faulted replay is rerun once, then a current report makes rerun illegal

invariants.statement: A pending draft exists exactly while the stage is editing.
A pending draft returns to inactive or reviewing.
A pending draft that returns to inactive was begun with nothing accepted.
An inactive session holds no drafts, report, progress or fault.
Replaying, choosing and finalizing always have accepted drafts.
A running replay has no report yet.
Choosing and finalizing hold a report without Error or Fatal outcomes.
Accepted drafts are ordered by applied position, then mutation id.
Each mutation has at most one accepted draft.
A fault is recorded only while drafts are accepted.
